freeze_instructions: Review, then set status to 'frozen', record the SHA-256 of this file in the progress log, and commit before the first provider call. No field may change after the first call; any change is a dated amendment that keeps the original hash.
numbering_note: Numbers 227-229 follow the 222-226 artifacts already on main; renumber before freezing if the workspace has used them since.
question: On the 20 Qwen main tasks of protocol 083, does cheap direct temperature-0.7 sampling without the multi-agent runtime reach the executable support of the nested trajectory pools, and how often does it collapse onto a single invalid response?

cohort.tasks: the 20 main-cohort tasks of protocol 083, in its frozen order; the eight gate tasks are excluded
cohort.outcome_blindness: Comparator outcomes are already known; every design choice below is fixed before any direct-sampling output is generated or inspected.

prompt.known_asymmetry: The runtime trajectories had recipe-search tool access; direct sampling has none. A direct-sampling deficit therefore cannot be attributed to the multi-agent structure alone, whereas direct parity or advantage holds despite strictly less context.

scoring.executor: the reference-free PlanCraft executor used for the protocol-083 oracle
scoring.semantic_key: the protocol-096 semantic normalization (IMPOSSIBLE variants merged; canonical plan otherwise)
scoring.references: used only offline for secondary exactness, never during generation

primary.definition: task-level indicator that any of the 200 qwen_direct responses is executable, compared with the C5 oracle on the same task
statistics: paired risk difference direct minus C5
two-sided exact McNemar on discordant tasks

primary.definition: share of the 20 tasks whose raw modal response occupies at least 0.80 of qwen_direct calls and is non-executable

secondary: E1 against C1 and against the temperature-zero final
unbiased coverage at k in {1, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200} per task, 1 - C(n-c,k)/C(n,k), averaged over tasks
distinct canonical plans and distinct executable plans per task
semantic modal share and E2 under semantic normalization
recorded tokens per arm and the direct-to-C5 token ratio
all endpoints for deepseek_direct, and the paired qwen-versus-deepseek collapse contrast (exact McNemar over tasks)

decision_rules.direct_parity_or_better: E1 point difference (direct minus C5) >= 0; superiority is claimed only if the exact McNemar p < 0.05
decision_rules.runtime_advantage: E1 point difference < 0 and exact McNemar p < 0.05
decision_rules.inconclusive: any other complete outcome; report the interval and do not describe the arms as equivalent
decision_rules.collapse_reporting: report E2 as a proportion with its exact interval; do not use the words 'common' or 'rare' unless the interval lies entirely above or below 0.5
decision_rules.scope: One benchmark, one cohort of 20 length-two tasks, two dated models. Calls are not independent task units; the 20 tasks are the inferential unit.

budget.planning_basis: protocol 096 used 37,298 tokens for 160 DeepSeek calls (about 233 per call); 8,000 planned calls are expected to use about 1.9M tokens
budget.budget_stop_interpretation: stop before the next call when a limit is reached and report incomplete, never an inferred null

integrity.invalid_call: provider error, access-denied or payment text, or missing usage; an empty visible answer with valid usage is a valid, non-executable response
integrity.rule: retain invalid calls in the artifact, exclude them from endpoints, and replace each with one new call at the same index; stop and report if more than 5% of calls in an arm are invalid
integrity.credential_rule: credentials only from process environment variables; never written to artifacts or logs

execution_guard: Live calls require --execute and DIRECT_SAMPLING_227_AUTHORIZED=1 and a frozen status in this file.
